recentItems.description:
National cycling champion Aifa Mehrin from Wayanad is selling homemade fresh fruit juices by the roadside under 'Aifa Naturals' to raise ₹8 lakh for an international down-hill racing cycle. When sponsors turned her down, the determined athlete chose to fund her own sporting dream rather than burdening her family.
